6 تواضخا They (two men standing together over a well, L) emulated each other [in drawing water and] in watering, or irrigating. (L, K.) ―
-b2- (tropical:) They (two horses) emulated each other [in running]; (L:) and تواضخت الإِبِلُ the camels emulated one another in going, journeying, or marching. (L, K *.) [See also 3.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
